name: AZYouthforce Internships
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley (BGCAZ)
what_you_do: First finish the 30 hour AZYF Academy for skills, mentors and career help. Then work a paid internship. Current listings include sports, office, digital marketing and college lab roles.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 21. Must be legally able to work in the U.S. A background check may be required. The page does not say whether Club membership is required; its application asks whether you are a BGCAZ member.
pay_detail: Paid internship. One listing shows a rate: GESD Office Assistant at $15.15 per hour. Other rates are not stated on the program pages.
duration: 30-hour academy first, then the internship. Length not stated on the program pages.
deadline_text: As of Nov 4, 2026, the apply page says fall internships are open. The internships page says spring applications are open. No deadline posted. Process takes about a month.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form (10 to 15 minutes). Then go to a Zoom info session and interview with staff. Then do the AZYF Academy at hubs in Mesa and Glendale. Apply at azyouthforce.org/apply.
notes: You may face a background check and a pre-employment drug test. Each role has its own age range, so check the listing. Most pay rates, length and exact dates were not on the pages, so email Samantha.Hansen@bgcaz.org or Kevin.Chavez@bgcaz.org.
